continuation.resume_point: PR #387 merged at 1b0b86492b3f4b387bb0645605140ce4a9bfcc3f. Isolated verifier v1 and focused 11-test evidence are in orchestra/tasks/spec224-remote-source-trust-authority-20261009/implementation-handoff.md. The verifier is unregistered and grants no dispatch permission. No authorized remote issuer/trust root/evidence store exists; runtime admission remains DENY. Next: owner approval and authority provisioning, then protected-start integration with atomic replay consumption and commit-time revocation recheck.
continuation.waiting_predicate: Reactivate when owner-approved issuer identity, trust-key catalog/resource, scoped tenant/profile policy, and dedicated evidence storage configuration are available and verifiable server-side.
